def hand_bell(name, loc):
    root = empty(name, loc)
    g = mat('bell_gold', hexc('#e2b23a'), 0.25, metal=0.8)
    cyl(name + '_b', 0.55, 0.7, (0, 0, 0), g, 16, parent=root, r2=0.25)
    sphere(name + '_c', 0.14, (0, 0, -0.45), g, parent=root, seg=10)
    cyl(name + '_h', 0.1, 0.5, (0, 0, 0.55), mat('bell_wood', hexc('#7a4a2a'), 0.6), 8, parent=root)
    return root
